systems.name: 1.1 Lump Routing & Parsing
systems.notes: Discover lumps from PK3, directory, and WAD sources. Route them to the correct parser based on namespace and priority order (MAPINFO before DECORATE, etc.).
tasks: Scan PK3 / directory / WAD and collect all lump names
Priority-ordered parsing: MAPINFO, SNDINFO, etc.
Handle WAD namespace subdirectories (maps/, sprites/, etc.)
Support nested PK3 loading within PK3s

systems.name: 1.2 DeHackEd / BEX Translation
systems.notes: Parse DeHackEd and BEX patches. Apply runtime table patches to entity directory, frame table, cheats, etc.
tasks: Parse DEHACKED lump as text (or BEX format)
Patch entity properties (health, speed, flags)
Modify frame table (sprite, duration, next frame, codepointer)
Apply cheat, ammo, and misc patches

systems.name: 1.3 MAPINFO / ZMAPINFO Parser
systems.notes: Translate map metadata: map name, music, sky, par time, episode flow, cluster definitions.
tasks: Parse MAPINFO / ZMAPINFO lumps
Set map metadata (level name, next map, secret map)
Assign music, sky textures, and par times
Define episode / hub structures

systems.name: 1.4 SNDINFO / ANIMDEFS / TERRAIN / LOCKDEFS
systems.notes: Parse sound aliases, animated flats/textures, footstep terrain definitions, and key lock definitions.
tasks: Parse SNDINFO – sound aliases and random sounds
Parse ANIMDEFS – animated textures and switches
Parse TERRAIN – footstep sound assignments
Parse LOCKDEFS – key definitions and lock types

systems.name: 1.5 ACS Load & Execution
systems.notes: Load BEHAVIOR bytecode, run OPEN scripts, handle line-triggered scripts, implement TagWait and PolyWait. Requires native GDExtension VM.
tasks: Load BEHAVIOR lump as raw bytecode (binary, not string)
Start OPEN scripts on map load
Execute line-triggered scripts via specials 80/82
Implement TagWait / PolyWait suspension and resumption
Notify sector tag completion when doors/floors/lifts finish

systems.name: 1.6 GPU Actor Tic & Codepointer Fallback
systems.notes: Run actor state ticks at 35 Hz. Use GPU compute shaders for performance; fall back to CPU codepointers when necessary.
tasks: Implement GPU-based actor frame tick at 35 Hz
CPU codepointer fallback for unsupported actions
Synchronise actor state with Godot scene tree
Handle state jumps, loops, and stops

systems.name: 1.7 Line Special Round-Trip
systems.notes: Ensure line specials invoked by ACS (e.g., Door_Open) correctly call LevelBuilder functions and that sector tag completions are reported back.
tasks: Route line specials 80/81/82/226/228 to ACS VM
Map ACS special numbers to LevelBuilder functions
Automatically notify TagWait when sector action completes
